en: Catch your breath: the tank holds
Breakdown! Pedal the diesel to repair
No power: pedal to restart the engines
The bogies are broken: hit the turret
Diesel: your watts drive the tracks. Hold 76-105% FTP to glow.
One engine does it all: the lever moves itself between Drive, Turret and Hoist.
Dynamo: steady cadence charges the bank that turns the turret.
Steam: build pressure to load a heavy shell.
Aim drill: the turret lines up on the wrecks.
